scope: Independent descriptive recomputation of two headless Garden-only logical-frame experiments with reversed initial order. Two warmups per zoom/process are excluded. Complete ordinary funded harmless exhibition states, order, phase, source identity and conservation were checked by the helper outside clocks. These measurements do not time actual engine/render frames, terrain overlap, player input, GPU, foreground or total end-to-end arrival wait.
limitations: Only8 measured pairs per process/zoom and16 combined; nearest-rank p95 equals the maximum in both. No confidence interval or stable tail claim.
A staged entry remains indivisible; the maximum individual pump is retained and there is no2ms or60FPS guarantee.
Logical pumps execute consecutively. Modeled wait is(deferred intervals)/assumed frame rate, not a measured wall duration or a faster-travel claim.

The helper times one initial request, each prepare+status call, publication and a separate adoption step; production repeats an idempotent view request each pending frame and also performs terrain/input/render work.
The reference already contains the accepted selection memo. This comparison isolates scheduling, not a second claim for that earlier optimization.
Every positive total-CPU delta remains recorded. Moving work across frames can cost more CPU and adds an explicit arrival wait. Ordinary walking is outside the staging trigger.
